2610.13438.title: Rollout-Time Intervention: Unlocking Agentic Reinforcement Learning Beyond Policy Limits
2610.13438.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a key paradigm for improving large language model (LLM) agents, enabling stronger reasoning, planning, and tool-use in interactive environments. However, existing agent RL methods remain fundamentally constrained by an on-policy reasoning bottleneck: when tasks exceed the model's current capability boundary, effective trajectories become extremely sparse and training often collapses. We introduce Rollout-Time Intervention (RTI), a technique designed to elicit successful trajectories beyond the policy's intrinsic exploration capacity. RTI operates by leveraging reward-side evidence (i.e., evaluation rubrics) during rollout to convert erroneous trajectories into successful ones, providing effective learning signals for tasks that the policy rarely solves on its own. Although intervention trajectories are inherently off-policy, we find that they can effectively guide policy optimization when trajectories with excessive distributional shifts are filtered out. Extensive experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate that RTI consistently outperforms RL baselines, enabling the post-trained policy to approach the performance of substantially stronger contemporary LLMs and, more importantly, transcend its original capability boundary. The code is available at https://github.com/Alibaba-NLP/qqr.
2610.13438.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習（RL）已成為提升大型語言模型（LLM）代理的重要範式，使其在互動環境中能夠進行更強的推理、規劃和工具使用。<lb/>然而，現有的代理RL方法仍然受到政策推理瓶頸的根本限制：當任務超出模型當前的能力邊界時，有效的軌跡變得極其稀疏，訓練往往會崩潰。<lb/>我們引入了滾動時間干預（RTI），這是一種旨在引出超出政策內在探索能力的成功軌跡的技術。<lb/>RTI通過在滾動過程中利用獎勵方面的證據（即評估標準）來運作，將錯誤的軌跡轉換為成功的軌跡，為政策自我解決的任務提供有效的學習信號。<lb/>儘管干預軌跡本質上是離政策的，但我們發現當過度分佈變化的軌跡被過濾掉時，它們可以有效地指導政策優化。<lb/>在五個基準上的廣泛實驗表明，RTI始終優於RL基準，使得後訓練的政策能夠接近當前更強大的LLM的性能，更重要的是，超越其原始的能力邊界。<lb/>代碼可在 https://github.com/Alibaba-NLP/qqr 獲得。
